attestations.text: HO Ch'o 何焯 (T. 潤千, 屺瞻, 茶仙, H. 義門) 1661–1722, scholar, bibliophile and calligrapher, was a native of Ch'ang-chou (Soochow), Kiangsu. He went to Peking in 1685 as a student in the Imperial Academy.

westernYears.note: Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.

accounts.evidence: 何焯，字屺瞻，長洲人。通經史百家之學。藏書數万卷，得宋、元舊槧，必手加讎校，粲然盈帙。學者稱義門先生，傳錄其說為義門讀書記。
